title: Continuum Backup & Recovery Agreement Terms — Renewal, Notices and Early Termination
content:
**1. Renewal.** A Continuum Backup & Recovery plan renews for the tier's automatic renewal term unless a signed non-renewal notice is received no later than the tier's notice period in days before the term end date, renewal rates rising by the tier's maximum renewal increase percent unless current discounted list rates are lower. A renewal may be recorded only while the plan status is active or suspended.

**2. Early termination.** An early termination notice ends the plan on the later of the requested date and the notice date plus the tier's notice period in days, with an early termination fee of the tier's early termination fee percentage of the minimum-commitment fees for the service months after the effective date through the term end date.

**3. Withdrawal.** Notices may be withdrawn before the effective date, reversing the fee.

**4. Signature.** Notices, withdrawals, tier changes, order cancellations and production failover authorizations are registered as change requests that take effect only on the authorized contact's signature.

## Clause 1 — the non-renewal deadline

The deadline is counted in calendar days back from the term end date; a notice received on the deadline day itself is in time, because the clause reads "no later than".

| Signed non-renewal notice received (hypothetical notice period of N calendar days) | Outcome at term end |
|---|---|
| N calendar days before the term end date | In time; the plan does not renew |
| More than N calendar days before the term end date | In time; the plan does not renew |
| N less one calendar days before the term end date, or later | Not in time; the plan renews for the automatic renewal term |
| No signed non-renewal notice | The plan renews for the automatic renewal term |

When the plan renews, it records the renewal term's start and end dates, its length, the renewal server, workstation and Microsoft 365 user rates, and the renewal server commitment.

| Plan status at the time of recording | May a renewal be recorded? |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| suspended | Yes |
| ordered, seeding, notice given, closed or cancelled | No |

## Clause 2 — effective date and fee

**Effective date.** The later of (a) the date the client requests and (b) the notice date plus the notice period in calendar days.

**Fee.** The early termination fee percentage multiplied by the total minimum-commitment fees of the service months that fall after the effective date, up to and including the term end date. The fee is invoiced when the early termination notice takes effect.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures only).** A notice period of 60 days, a notice received on day 0 asking for termination on day 15, minimum-commitment fees of 1,000.00 USD for each service month, 6 service months after the effective date through the term end date, and a fee percentage of 50 percent.

| Quantity | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Notice date plus notice period | Day 0 plus 60 days | Day 60 |
| Effective date | The later of day 15 and day 60 | Day 60 |
| Minimum-commitment fees after the effective date | 6 months multiplied by 1,000.00 USD | 6,000.00 USD |
| Early termination fee | 50 percent of 6,000.00 USD | 3,000.00 USD |

Had the client asked for termination on day 90, the effective date would be day 90, the later of the two.

## Plan status while a notice runs

| Plan status | What it means |
|---|---|
| notice given | The client's signed notice of non-renewal or early termination has taken effect |
| active (after withdrawal) | The client withdrew the notice before its effective date; any early termination fee is reversed |
| closed | The effective date is reached; backups stop and retention runs out under the post-cancellation window |
